fusions.name: Shriek on the Wing
fusions.desc: A winged rat stoops on the first enemy in its path with a shriek, biting for 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Falling Roost
fusions.desc: The colony drops from above onto every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour, with a 60% chance to leave each target [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rafters Cry as One
fusions.desc: The whole colony screeches at once, holding every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Night Shift
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 10% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
